title: Cricket basics
examples: What is the main goal when you are batting?
Can you explain the difference between a run and a wicket?
What equipment does a bowler need?

explain.say: Today we learn about the game of cricket. It has three main parts.
Batting means you try to hit the ball far. You use a special bat to hit it.

items: Step 2: Ball is bowled toward the batter
Step 3: Batter hits the ball with a bat

explain.say: Bowling is when you throw the ball to the batter. You try to make it hard to hit.

items: Step 2: Bowler throws the ball over
Step 3: Ball travels to the batter

explain.say: Fielding is when players stand around the ground. They try to catch the ball or stop it.
You score runs when you hit the ball and run between the wickets. This is how you score points.
A wicket falls when the ball hits the wickets or a fielder catches it. This ends your turn to bat.

faq.q: What is the main difference between a run and a wicket?
faq.a: A run is a point you score by running. A wicket means you are out and cannot bat anymore.
asks: How do I score points in cricket?
What does it mean to be out?

faq.q: Does the bowler always bowl to the same spot?
faq.a: No, the bowler tries to bowl to different areas to make it harder. They aim for the batter's weak spots.

faq.q: Can fielders catch the ball even if it bounces?
faq.a: Generally, a fielder must catch it before it touches the ground. If it bounces, they might not get a chance.
asks: How do fielders get the ball?
Is a bounce okay to catch?

faq.q: What happens if the ball hits the stumps directly?
faq.a: If the ball hits the wickets, it is usually considered a wicket. This means the batter is out.

faq.q: Do you need special shoes to play cricket?
faq.a: While specialized gear helps, you mainly need appropriate sports shoes for grip. Safety is very important in this game.
asks: What shoes are best for cricket?

facts: Cricket involves players batting, bowling, and fielding.
Runs are scored by the batters running between the wickets.
A wicket falls when the ball hits the wickets or a fielder catches it.
The bowler throws the ball towards the batter's wickets.

quiz.say: If a batter hits the ball and runs to the other end, what has happened?
quiz.why: Running between the wickets is the way batters score runs.

wrong.1: A wicket means you are out, not that you scored points.
wrong.2: Being out means your turn to bat has ended.
wrong.3: Caught means a fielder has taken the ball before it hit the ground.

quiz.say: What action does the bowler perform?
quiz.show: Throwing the ball to the batter
quiz.why: The bowler is the player whose job is to throw the ball to the batter.

wrong.0: Running is what happens after the ball is hit, not the action of throwing.
wrong.2: Batting is what the player does when they hit the ball.
wrong.3: Fielding is standing around to stop the ball after it is hit.

quiz.say: If a fielder catches the ball before it hits the ground, what happens to the batter?
quiz.why: Catching the ball is one way that a batter can lose their wicket.

wrong.0: The game continues; only the batter is out for now.
wrong.1: The bowler just completed their turn; the game continues.
wrong.3: Scoring runs only happens when the batter hits the ball and runs.
